import pandas as pd

# Read the CSV file
df = pd.read_csv('/Users/bakulbadwal/Documents/GitHub/gaia-agent/runs/practice_files/p04-csv-pm25-ranking/air_quality_hourly.csv')

# Calculate mean PM2.5 for each station, ignoring NaN values
station_means = df.groupby('station')['pm25_ugm3'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)

print("Mean PM2.5 by station (highest first):")
print(station_means)

print("\nTop 3 stations:")
top_3 = station_means.head(3)
print(top_3)

# Format as comma-separated list
result = ', '.join(top_3.index.tolist())
print(f"\nResult: {result}")
